title: Constraint: Even-Odd Index Rules
constraints: `arr[i]` is even when `i` is even and odd when `i` is odd.
The even-index elements `arr[0], arr[2], …, arr[10]` are strictly increasing.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Compare with the previous even element: `arr[i] > arr[i-2]` for even i ≥ 2.

examples.check: elements at even indices are even
examples.title: parity
